name: Valdepeñas de Jaén (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided purple over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdepeñas de Jaén (a cross of Saint James and a crescent on yellow within a bordure of castles and lions).
history: Municipal flag of Valdepeñas de Jaén; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdepeñas de Jaén arms — cross of Saint James and crescent on yellow within a bordure of castles and lions
